desc: Index/loop table for the music archive Data/Sound_BGM/Sound_BGM_0.dat. When adding a new track: add NNN.ogg to the archive (d5lib.sound.build_track), a row here (loop_start = intro samples, loop_end = intro+loop samples) and a music.dat row if it should appear in the jukebox.

fields.name: id
fields.desc: file number: member "<id>.ogg" of Data/Sound_BGM/Sound_BGM_0.dat (PS_FS_V1); all 78 match the archive 1:1. Referenced by music.dat file and script bgm_play

fields.name: label
fields.desc: internal JP label (e.g. "ＢＧＭ０１", "配信ＢＧＭ１－１" = DLC, "ＪＩＮ" = jingles)

fields.name: loop_start
fields.desc: loop start in samples (48 kHz) = sample count of the intro Ogg stream (verified on all tracks); 0 for jingles

fields.name: loop_end
fields.desc: loop end in samples = intro + loop stream samples (verified; outro never played)
